title: EquiDermAI: An Inclusive Deep-Generative Framework to Overcome Racial & Regional Barriers in Skin Disease Diagnosis
summary: EquiDermAI combines generated skin-lesion images and compact models to target diagnostic disparities, with full validation still ongoing.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: IIT Madras describes skin-tone data augmentation and on-device dermatology models. Mobile prototyping and validation are ongoing. Fairer diagnostic performance, lower energy use, and access in resource-constrained settings are intended benefits. No reduction in existing health disparities has been demonstrated.
purpose: Improve dermatology-model performance across skin tones and low-resource devices.

ratings.reason: EquiDermAI is at initial mobile-prototype validation; no patient is shown to have benefited.
Fairer skin-tone performance and lower mortality are intended effects. Changes in existing health disparities remain unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 22: EquiDermAI: An Inclusive Deep-Generative Framework to Overcome Racial & Regional Barriers in Skin Disease Diagnosis

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: EquiDermAI targets skin-tone gaps in dermatology AI
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
